leads.title: Leads & companies
leads.body: Start every opportunity as a lead. Attach contacts, notes, and follow-ups. Use the pipeline board when you want stage-level motion, and Companies when the account itself matters.

outreach.title: Outreach
outreach.body: Keep reusable templates, sequences, checklists, and tags here. Render copy with client context, then push it into a proposal when you are ready.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.body: Generate from a lead, refine the body, and send when the pitch is sharp. Status updates keep you honest about what is still waiting on a reply.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.body: Turn agreed work into a contract, generate the document, and keep the paper trail tied to the same engagement.

projects.title: Projects & portal
projects.body: Delivery lives on the project: requirements, milestones, files, and reports. Share a portal link when the client needs a calm view without the whole workspace.

coach.title: AI Coach
coach.body: Ask for pricing, negotiation, or follow-up language when you are stuck — then insert the answer into a proposal or save it as outreach copy.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Watch open leads, win rate, pipeline value, and the funnel. Use it as a compass, not a second job.
